verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the public GitHub repo stripe/terminal-js, which suggests the Terminal JS SDK source can be read. The pack never states its license, and says nothing about the source of the core Terminal service, the reader firmware, or the other SDKs (Android, iOS, React Native). The OpenAPI spec repo is an API description, not product source, so it does not count. Missing for 10: an explicitly stated open-source license, public source for the other Terminal SDKs and components, and independent corroboration.
